text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm not really in the mood. I 
appreciate the thought, though."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Now, what was the next menu again...? Let 
us finish it while I still have strength 
to spare."

No Reason seems a bit tired. We might need 
to review her schedule.
